expected_binding.relation_statement: The authenticated requester is the SMF NF service consumer that previously created the addressed Individual SM Context for the PDU session and received the URI for that resource, and may invoke release on that same resource.

existing_protection.coverage_notes: The specification describes the intended procedure in which an NF service consumer, e.g. an SMF, invokes the release custom operation using the Individual SM Context URI received from a successful Create operation, but it does not state that the NEF verifies that the authenticated requester is the same SMF or NF service consumer that previously created or is otherwise bound to the addressed SM context.

evidence_refs.role: resource addressing via previously returned URI

evidence_used.evidence_role: selects SMF requester and previously created context relation
evidence_used.quoted_text: The Delete service operation is invoked by a NF Service Consumer (e.g. a SMF) towards the NEF, when the PDU Session Release is initiated and a SM context for NIDD has been previously created on NEF for the PDU session.
evidence_used.rationale: This identifies the representative executable procedure as an SMF/NF service consumer invoking Delete/release for a PDU session whose NIDD SM context was previously created on the NEF.

evidence_used.evidence_role: selects concrete resource URI and request body
evidence_used.quoted_text: The request body shall contain a "SmContextReleaseData" object.
evidence_used.rationale: The supplied OpenAPI inventory maps SmContextReleaseData for this endpoint to the required field cause with the sole enum value PDU_SESSION_RELEASED, giving a concrete request body for the release trigger.

gaps: The supplied TS evidence describes use of the URI received from a successful Create operation, but does not specify an explicit authorization check binding the authenticated requester to that creator.

expected_binding.relation_statement: The authenticated NF Service Consumer acting as the SMS-SC is expected to access only the MoSmInfo sendsms resource for the UE identified by the path SUPI when that UE belongs to that SMS-SC.

existing_protection.mechanism: A 403 error cause is specified for the condition where the user does not belong to the SMS-SC.
existing_protection.protected_relation: addressed user/UE belongs to the SMS-SC
existing_protection.coverage_notes: The specification identifies a forbidden condition for a user not belonging to the SMS-SC, which is relevant to the SMS-SC-to-addressed-UE relation. It does not directly require verification that the authenticated NF Service Consumer is that SMS-SC, nor does it state a mandatory requester-to-SUPI authorization check.

evidence_used.quoted_text: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. SMS-SC) shall transmit MO SMS message to NEF by using the HTTP POST method
evidence_used.rationale: This identifies the representative requester type as an SMS-SC NF Service Consumer and selects POST as the executable operation trigger.

evidence_used.quoted_text: The NF Service Consumer shall send a POST request to the resource representing the UE's Mobile Originated Short Message Information resource (i.e. …/sm-contexts/{supi}/sendsms) of the NEF.
evidence_used.rationale: This maps the request to the addressed UE resource selected by the path SUPI.

sendsms

evidence_used.quoted_text: -USER_NOT_SERVICE_CENTER, if the user didn't belongs to the SMS-SC;
evidence_used.rationale: This error cause is the supplied TS indication that the authorization-relevant relation is whether the addressed user belongs to the SMS-SC.

gaps: The OpenAPI request schema inventory for multipart/related exposes no exact body field paths, so no SmsData or SMS payload part can be listed in body_required_fields despite TS requiring an SMS message body.
The requester NF type and SMS-SC-to-SUPI ownership relation must be supplied by the authorization test fixture rather than by request body fields.
